attrs.ParamsAttr

Load this module to enable the #[params="N"] attribute and the generated Params instances.
This file loads Stdlib.Classes.Morphisms and registers its Params class for the plugin under the private key rocq_attrs.params.type.
Plugin-local support covers Definition and section Let (local-only). Other declaration commands need Rocq-core hook plumbing; do not rely on #[params] there yet.
From Stdlib.Classes Require Export Morphisms.

Register Params as rocq_attrs.params.type.

Declare ML Module "rocq-attrs.params".
